What is crypto? Monkeys use leaves to
buy
things. Leaves used by most monkeys as
currency. But there are some downsides
to leaves. Leaves controlled by monkey
banks. Every time monkeys buy something
with leaves, monkey banks take a bit
extra. Buying things with leaves often
takes long time for monkey banks to
process, especially if monkeys send
leaves to other monkey countries.
Monkey banks can print more leaves which
can cause inflation. Not every monkey
has access to monkey bank. Leaves can be
faked. Monkey bank isn't always open. So
monkeys invent new currency. Monkeys use
bananas. How does crypto work? Bananas
are not controlled by one monkey or
monkey bank. Bananas are controlled by
entire troop. Every time monkey buys
something with banana, there are usually
no fees or maybe just a very small fee
unless it's particularly busy. Buying
things with bananas is very quick, even
internationally. Every monkey can do it
without having to go to monkey bank.
Some bananas have limited supply, which
means no inflation. Bananas can't be
faked. Monkeys can also trade bananas
24/7.

How do tariffs work? Tariffs can be
dollar amount or a percentage of the
cost of item. Most monkey countries use
percentage tariffs, but they call them
ad valorum. To make monkey sound smart,
tariffs can get really specific. Unripe
banana can have different tariffs to
ripe ones even though they both banana.
Even banana cannot escape bureaucracy.
Trade terms. When monkey government not
use tariffs, this is called free trade.
When monkey country export more banana
than they import, this called a trade
surplus. But when monkey country import
more banana than export, this is called
trade deficit. What happens when tariffs
are used? Price of imported banana goes
up. Monkeyland banana stores happy as
there are no more cheap bananas to
compete with. But less banana
competition can also mean banana quality
go down. Local banana becomes
monkeykey's only option. Local price can
also go up to just under banana land
banana. Monkeyland monkeys frustrated.
Monkeys have to choose between paying
more for good banana or eat worse banana
for cheap.

What are credit cards? Monkeys use
leaves to pay for bananas. Monkey eat
banana. Life good. Monkey want more
banana but doesn't have the leaves to
pay for them. So monkey use a leaf card.
This card allows monkey to buy bananas
now and pay later. Monkey is borrowing
leaves from monkey bank. How do credit
cards work? When monkey uses leaf card
to buy bananas, the monkey bank pays for
those bananas. Monkey now owes the bank
those leaves. Monkey has around 30 days
to pay back the leaves. If monkey pays
back the leaves in time, everything is
fine. If not, well, we'll talk about
that in a minute. How do you get a
credit card? First, monkey go to the
monkey bank.
But monkey bank won't give leaf cards to
just any monkey. Monkey have to prove
they pay for things regularly. They pay
back leaves they owe and they pay back
on time. All this information goes into
one number called a credit score. This
is a number monkey banks use to decide
how likely you are to pay back your
leaves on time. The better monkeys
score, the more likely they are to be
approved for a leaf card and the more
leaves they are allowed to borrow. In
the US, a score above 740 is good. A
score above 800 is very good. While
anything below 580 is not worth eating,
I I mean not good. Credit limit. But
using a leaf card doesn't mean Monkey
has unlimited leaves. In fact, most
beginner cards only let Monkey borrow
around 1,000 leaves. But as Monkey Bank
trust Monkey more, they allow more
leaves to be borrowed.
